nodes.title: INSTRUCTIONS
widgets_values:
=== SVI 2.0 Pro Workflow ===

SHARED: Models, VAE, STEPS, CFG, SHIFT, OVERLAP_FRAMES, ANCHOR_IMAGE

EACH CLIP HAS: Prompt, Seed, Generation, Frame Extract, Concatenation, Preview

TO DUPLICATE:
1. Copy entire CLIP 2 group
2. Connect motion_latent from prev clip to WanVideoAddExtraLatent
3. Connect prev clip's accumulated_images to new ImageBatchMulti input 1
4. Update seed and prompt

OUTPUT: Final video saved to ComfyUI/output/

nodes.title: DUPLICATION GUIDE
widgets_values:
DUPLICATE CLIP 2 FOR MORE CLIPS:

1. Select nodes 150-182 (entire CLIP 2 group)
2. Ctrl+D to duplicate, move below
3. Connect CLIP 2's motion_latent (node 175) to new WanVideoAddExtraLatent
4. Connect CLIP 2's accumulated_images (node 181 output) to new ImageBatchMulti image_1 input
5. Update SEED and PROMPT
6. Move save_output=true to the last clip's VHS_VideoCombine

widgets_values: A person walking through a forest, natural movement, cinematic lighting

widgets_values: The person continues walking deeper into the forest, camera follows smoothly
